profile.name: Mohaiminul Islam
profile.headline: Full-Stack MERN Developer | React, Next.js, NestJS
profile.summary: Full-stack MERN developer with professional experience building React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, and MongoDB applications. Project work includes REST APIs, payment integrations, reverse image search flows, admin dashboards, and user-facing web products. Strong algorithmic foundation through Codeforces, LeetCode, Google Kickstart, and Google Code Jam.

projects.title: Image Reverse Search
projects.desc: Built a production web platform with a Next.js frontend and standalone Express.js/MongoDB backend for image ingestion, reverse-search routing, user submissions, payment processing, and admin analytics.

Built a responsive bilingual user interface
Integrated Paddle payments and SerpApi reverse image matching
Added follow-up tracking plus an admin panel for oversight and analytics

projects.title: Lose to Gain

Integrated automated email delivery for diet reports
Used Gemini API to analyze nutrition labels from packaged food images
Implemented an admin panel for system oversight and user trend analysis
